svg.title: The fastest, the cheapest and the option in between for one trip across Porto Alegre
svg.desc: A map of Porto Alegre with three trips from Jardim Carvalho, in the east, to Praia de Belas, south of the centre, and beside it their time, fare and transfers. The fastest takes 53 minutes on three buses and costs R$ 12.00; with two buses and the transfer discount, 57 minutes for R$ 7.20; the cheapest, a single bus for R$ 4.80, takes 86 minutes, 65 of them on foot.
